title: Even part in the last coordinate
statement: For a function $f:\{-1,1\}^{n+1}\to\mathbb R$, define its even part in the last coordinate to be the function on $\{-1,1\}^n$ given by $x\mapsto \bigl(f(x,1)+f(x,-1)\bigr)/2$.
